description: Takes a vault token address (from earn-vaults lpToken.address), source token, amount and wallet, returns an unsigned EVM transaction that swaps + bridges + deposits in one step. Cross-chain supported: deposit from any chain into any vault. Uses LI.FI Composer under the hood. A 30 bps integrator fee is embedded. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

fromAddress.description: Wallet that signs and receives vault tokens

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

vaultToken.description: Vault LP token address from earn-vaults

name: earn_deposit
